header: Integrations your finance team asks about
subheadline: Nine integrations come as standard, with no middleware. Finance teams ask about these four first, and each runs on a schedule you set.

items.title: DATEV
items.description_text: Job sheets, parts and hours are posted as bookable entries, with cost centres per contract.

items.title: BMD NTCS
items.description_text: Closed work orders, credit notes and technician hours are transferred every night.

items.title: Microsoft Entra ID
items.description_text: Single sign-on. A technician who leaves the payroll system loses access automatically.

items.title: Sage 50
items.description_text: Draft invoices are created from signed job sheets and keep your own number ranges.
